scenarios.name: Inspect the first-save preview of a solid part

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user sketches a 40 by 25 mm rectangle on the XY datum plane and extrudes it 20 mm
the unsaved part containing that visible rectangular solid is active
the first-save preview settings are configured to save an isometric component view
the Save As dialog opens with a proposed part filename selected
Active Component Iso View on Save is selected
the preview area displays a shaded isometric block
